# Data quality

**112 data quality tests covering 21 of 21 tables**: 57 pipeline expectations (row-level, enforced while data flows through the Lakeflow pipeline) and 55 post-load checks (keys, referential integrity, freshness, reconciliations and the risk job outputs, run by job task `data_quality_checks`).

Expectation actions: **warn** keeps the row and records the violation in the pipeline event log, **drop row** removes it, **fail update** stops the pipeline. Post-load checks with severity **error** fail the job; **warn** checks are only recorded in `ops_dq_results`.
